base_text: You are building a wooden bookshelf in the garage. Your neighbor walks in to borrow a hammer.

variants.warm: They offer to hold the boards steady while you drive the nails.
variants.cold: They grab the tool from the bench without asking and walk out.
variants.adversarial: They point at your joints and state the wood quality is extremely poor.
variants.neutral: They take the tool, say a brief word of thanks, and leave.

base_text: You are painting a landscape on a large canvas. Someone approaches your easel from behind.

variants.warm: They offer a gentle remark about your use of color and shading.
variants.cold: They glance briefly at the canvas and walk away without speaking.
variants.adversarial: They point out mistakes in your perspective and shake their head at your work.
variants.neutral: They stand and watch for a moment before moving on their way.

base_text: You are knitting a scarf on the porch. A passerby stops near the steps.

variants.warm: They give a nod and say the pattern looks extremely intricate.
variants.cold: They stare blankly at your hands for a second, then keep walking.
variants.adversarial: They point at the yarn color and tell you it looks entirely outdated.
variants.neutral: They nod in your direction, fix their coat, and continue on their way.

base_text: You are fixing a broken bicycle chain on the sidewalk. A neighbor pauses next to you.

variants.warm: They crouch down beside you and offer to help hold the bicycle pedals.
variants.cold: They step around you to avoid the grease and do not make eye contact.
variants.adversarial: They shake their head and claim you are just making the problem worse.
variants.neutral: They wait for you to move your repair tools so they can walk past.

base_text: You are writing code on your laptop at a cafe. The person at the next table leans over.

variants.warm: They politely ask what project you are working on so intently right now.
variants.cold: They silently pull their chair away to create more distance between the tables.
variants.adversarial: They loudly state that the sound of your typing is extremely distracting to them.
variants.neutral: They reach across to grab a napkin dispenser and then sit back down quietly.
